svg.title: P2 parallel_j — cell and product ownership
svg.desc: For each row, two workers request two columns at a time; seven columns leave a final chunk of one. Colors and thread labels identify owners; the small strip in each output cell lists k-product owners left to right. Dynamic and guided allocation is illustrative.
svg.text: All values = 4. Each colored strip = k0 → k3.
One tile = one A[0,k] × B[k,0] product
Dynamic: a worker finishes its chunk, then requests another
For row i=0: seven columns, two workers, dynamic:2
Chunk sizes: 2, 2, 2, 1. The last chunk contains the one remaining column.
Worker IDs show one possible request order; workers do not take mandatory turns.
After the row joins, i=1 starts a new column team and queue.
